scenes.headline: How GLM-5.3-Flash keeps a million tokens cheap to serve
scenes.sub: Linear and sparse attention, three to one, plus IndexPool and mHC.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Clover! GLM-5.3-Flash reads a million tokens, but most of its layers keep no cache at all. Here's how it's built.

scenes.text: Only eleven of forty-five layers keep a KV cache. The other thirty-four carry a fixed-size recurrent state that doesn't grow with the conversation.
scenes.say: The idea: only eleven of its forty-five layers keep a KV cache. The rest carry a fixed-size state that never grows.

scenes.title: Three linear layers, then one sparse

steps.say: After three dense layers, every layer routes each token to eight of two hundred eighty-eight experts.
Thirty-four layers use KDA linear attention: a recurrent state of fixed size, however long the context gets.
One in four is sparse latent attention. Only these eleven keep a cache, and each reads just two thousand forty-eight positions.
But something has to pick those positions. That's the indexer, and it scans every key.

scenes.title: IndexPool: the tax sparse attention hides

steps.label: The selector scores every key: linear in context
steps.say: Attention stays flat, but the selector grows with context. Past a certain length, the selector is the cost.

steps.label: Four indexer keys pooled into one
steps.note: the newest block is never pooled
steps.say: IndexPool pools four keys into one before scoring. A quarter the scan, a quarter the indexer cache. Not sublinear, just divided by four.

left.title: One residual stream
items: Every block writes over one channel
left.say: A normal residual stream is one channel, and every block writes over it.

right.title: Four mixed branches
right.say: mHC widens it to four branches, with mixing kept doubly stochastic so none can drain the others. Another lab dropped that mixing the same week.

scenes.label: KV cache per layer than GLM-5.3, with attention compute cut 3.01x
scenes.note: Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash still use slightly less
scenes.say: Against GLM-5.3, the cache per layer is four point four four times smaller. Two rivals, Z.ai admits, are still slightly smaller.

scenes.text: The model's shape is a serving decision: eleven cache-bearing layers, because memory bandwidth said so.

recap: 34 linear layers, 11 sparse layers with a cache
IndexPool divides the selector's scan by four
mHC mixes four residual branches, conservatively
scenes.say: To recap: mostly cache-free layers, a pooled selector, and a four-branch residual stream.
